walkthrough: Identify the given information: in time $t$ the mass gains gravitational potential energy $E_p$ and also gains kinetic energy $E_k$.
State the governing rule: average power $P = W / t$, where $W$ is the total work done on the mass.
By conservation of energy, the input work must supply both increases, so $W = E_p + E_k$.
Substitute into the power equation to get $P = (E_p + E_k) / t$.
Check units: energy in $\text{J}$ divided by time in $\text{s}$ gives $\text{W}$, which is correct for power, while options multiplied by $t$ give $\text{J s}$.
